0022600130.text: The Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home) host the Sacramento Kings (0-3) in San Antonio's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Spurs currently 9th in the West and sitting on a one-game winning streak after a 1-0 road start, while the Kings are on a three-game losing streak and 15th in the West. San Antonio will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Keegan Murray is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
